messages:
Mike: FYI I'm seeing a p95 uptick after yesterday's queue tweak. Attached perf run: https://perf.redwood/internal/2421/run2
Anya: I traced it. We get many 1-token decode batches right after prefill ends; kernel flips each time and we pay the switch cost.
Lee: logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:03:10Z] req=0x1a SelectedKernel=prefill_kv_opt batch=12 phase=prefill
[2026-03-18T09:03:10Z] req=0x1a SelectedKernel=decode_fast batch=1 phase=decode kernel_switch=true
```
Kai: queue traces show token_budget governor cuts prefill aggressively; decode wakes immediately and starves for batchmates. Idea: introduce a short "grace join" window (configurable ms) where decode tasks can join an ending prefill batch if kernels compatible and KV is fresh.
Anya: also consider avoiding kernel switch for single-token decodes by executing a micro-decode path on the prefill kernel.
Mike: can we prototype small, behind a flag? need metrics and canary.
Kai: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7910. Changes: grace_ms=6 (configurable), join if kernel_compat & kv_age < 12ms, bump decode token_target to 10 in flagged mode, metric phase_joined/phase_reject.
Perf-bot: [auto] bench: mixed chat/completion, 1200 hosts. p95 -7.3%, p99 -3.9%, p50 +0.6%. Artifacts: https://s3.redwood/bench/2421/soft-join.csv
Lee: watch mem residency for kernel switch reduction; joining may increase resident set for some kernels.
Mike: rollout plan: gated merge -> canary 5% for 2h, observe p95/p50/kv_hit/phase_joined. auto-rollback if p95 +4%.
Deploy-bot: scheduled runtime/soft-join -> prod-canary (5%) 2026-03-19T04:00:00Z
Kai: will monitor dashboards and add alert on phase_join_reject_rate.
Anya: small follow-up: when kernel_compat=false, keep current behavior and tag rejection reason (quant mismatch / missing kv).
Mike: good. Add checklist to PR and bring to eng-runtime stand tomorrow. :+1:
